note: Artifacts too large for git. Fetch with scripts/fetch_models.py. The calibration files committed in models/ (gop_reference.json, word_duration_stats.json) are measurements of THIS acoustic model's behaviour and are wrong for any other -- see acoustic_model_sha256. vowel_classifier.joblib additionally requires the wav2vec2 checkpoint; without it the engine disables vowel-identity checking rather than failing.

models/yoruba_acoustic.zip.purpose: MFA acoustic model, trained on 193,309 utterances from 2,801 speakers (~118 h: SLR86, studio corpus, YECS). Everything else is calibrated against it.

models/vowel_classifier.joblib.purpose: Vowel identity, 575,125 vowels from 2,786 speakers, fitted to models/finetuned_utterance. It names its encoder in its metadata and the engine loads that, so the pair cannot drift.

models/tone_classifier.joblib.purpose: Tone classifier, trained on this aligner's boundaries.

models/finetuned_utterance/model.safeten.purpose: The encoder the vowel classifier is fitted to. LyngualLabs' mms-300m-yoruba-english fine-tuned on whole utterances and truncated to the 16 layers the engine reads. Required: the classifier reads noise from any other encoder.

vowel_classifier.caveat: Held-out composition changed between versions as more speakers entered the corpus, so figures are comparable only within a controlled comparison.

controlled_comparison.note: Identical rows, identical classifier, identical speaker split.

corpora: studio corpus (michsethowusu, Waxal, IroyinSpeech, Common Voice 26.0, ljspeech, thisniyi)

models/whisper-yoruba.purpose: Whisper transcription for --transcribe, which recognises what a learner actually said and so names substituted words the 9,092-entry lexicon does not contain. Optional: prompted practice never loads it. Fetch with --include-optional.
